name: cursor-agent
competence: Edits that first require finding every call site or usage across an unfamiliar repository, using a semantic index rather than grep
weaknesses: depends on its index being current
less strong on pure greenfield work

unattended.note: -f / --yolo: bypasses confirmation for shell commands and file writes

sandbox.note: -w / --worktree: isolates work in a disposable git worktree

plan.prompt_prefix: Create a high-level execution plan first, then carry it out. Task:

parallel.prompt_prefix: Use your repository index to find every affected call site first, then apply the change across all of them in one pass rather than file by file. Task:

readonly.note: --plan / --mode=plan: read-only planner that analyses without modifying files

no_op.prompt_prefix: Your previous run described this work instead of doing it. Do not restate the plan -- make the edits on disk now, and finish by listing the files you changed. Task:
no_op.note: re-dispatch with an explicit apply-the-edits instruction

stuck.prompt_prefix: You are running headless: nobody can answer a question, and asking one ends the run with nothing done. Make reasonable assumptions, complete the task, and record those assumptions in your final message. Task:
stuck.note: re-dispatch telling the agent no answer can arrive

failed.prompt_prefix: A previous attempt at this task errored out. Inspect the working tree for half-applied changes, clean them up, then complete the task. Task:
failed.note: re-dispatch after checking the tree for partial work

auth_check.fail_pattern: not logged in|please log in|no active session
